subject: Ignite HackLab: maintainer stipends + demo credits request
messages:
From: Evelyn Hughes <evelyn@ignitefoundation.org>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-03T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Request: maintainer stipends + demo credits for Ignite HackLab 2027

Hi Soojin,

Thanks again for taking a minute on the phone last week. Ignite HackLab (June 11-13) is shaping up — we expect ~400 attendees and a 60-team hack sprint. We run a small maintainer program where we pay leads and provide cloud + demo credits so open-source maintainers can attend and showcase integrations.

Request: would Redwood consider: 12 maintainer stipends ($500 honorarium each), plus 30 demo credits (one per demo table) worth of hosted trial credits (we typically use credits during the 48-hour sprint for live demos)? We also ask for two speaker travel stipends, if possible.

Attached is our sponsorship packet and the maintainer selection criteria. If you need a budget breakdown or more detail on how credits are consumed, happy to send figures.

A few things that help us prioritize vendors: clear usage limits, the ability to pre-provision credits to specific email addresses, and a short redemption window (we start onboarding May 28).

Thanks — would love to get a yes/no this week so we can finalize the welcome kit.

Best,
Evelyn Hughes
Partnerships Director, Ignite Foundation
---
Attachment: Ignite_HackLab_2027_request.pdf (application packet, 540KB)
From: Soojin Lee <soojin@redwood.com>

Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-03T12:01:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: maintainer stipends + demo credits for Ignite HackLab 2027

Hi Evelyn — thank you, and congrats on the turnout plans.

Quick clarifying questions so I can route this to our program team:
- Is the $500 honorarium per maintainer a hard cap, or do you want us to recommend a different tier?
- For the 30 demo credits, do you mean 30 separate promo top-ups (one per table) or a pool of credits we can allocate?
- Can you confirm the earliest redemption date (you mentioned May 28) and whether attendees will use the hosted API or self-hosted images for demos?

If you can reply with those, I’ll put a short memo together and loop in Marissa (community grants) and Karthik (partnerships ops). If everything looks standard we can usually approve community allocations in 3–5 business days.

Best,
Soojin Lee
Community Programs, Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Request: maintainer stipends + demo credits for Ignite HackLab 2027

Hi Soojin,

Thanks — answers below:
- $500 is our standard ask; a slightly higher stipend for lead maintainers is possible but $500 is ideal.
- 30 separate promo top-ups (one per demo table) — each is typically $200 worth of hosted credits.
- Redemption: we need credits provisioned by May 28. Demos will use hosted API keys; we can provide the attendee list and emails for pre-provisioning.

If there’s any internal form to complete I can fill it out today.

Appreciate the quick turnaround.

—Evelyn
From: Soojin Lee <soojin@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-04T10:09:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Ignite HackLab: maintainer stipends + demo credits request

Marissa / Karthik — forwarding the request from Ignite Foundation. Key asks: 12 maintainer stipends at $500 each; 30 demo top-ups (~$200 credit each) to be pre-provisioned to emails by May 28. Also two travel stipends (est $600 ea).

My recommendation: approve stipends and demo credits, offer a 60-day trial extension on top of demo credits so maintainers can validate integrations after the event. Proposed package: $6,000 in stipends (12 x $500), $6,000 in demo credits (30 x $200), 2 x $600 travel stipends = $1,200; total program value $13,200. We can flag as community/maintainer support (non-deal).

Can you confirm fiscal/approval? If green, I’ll send formal terms and a DocuSign for record-keeping.

Thanks,
Soojin
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-05T09:18:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Ignite HackLab: maintainer stipends + demo credits request

Sounds good to me — approve the package with two small edits:
- Increase two lead maintainer stipends to $750 (so 10 x $500, 2 x $750) — helps secure leads and is within our community grants cadence.
- Cap demo credit redemptions to a single-use promo code per table and expire codes 90 days after the event to avoid open-ended liability.

Please route accounting to mark this as "community grant — event support" and create a simple approval form (I attached a signed approval sheet). Once we have Ignite's attendee list we can pre-provision credits.

Marissa Cole
Director, Community Programs — Redwood Inference
